tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('focus_billing.csv')
# Determine month from ChargePeriodStart (daily export) - check distinct months
df['month'] = df['ChargePeriodStart'].str[:7]
print(df['month'].value_counts())
# Also check BillingPeriodStart
df['bmonth'] = df['BillingPeriodStart'].str[:7]
print(df['bmonth'].value_counts())

tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('focus_billing.csv')
df['month'] = df['ChargePeriodStart'].str[:7]
aug = df[df.month=='2026-08'].groupby('ResourceId')['BilledCost'].sum()
sep = df[df.month=='2026-09'].groupby('ResourceId')['BilledCost'].sum()
allr = set(aug.index)|set(sep.index)
res=[]
for r in allr:
    a = aug.get(r,0.0); s = sep.get(r,0.0)
    res.append((r, a, s, s-a))
res.sort(key=lambda x: -abs(x[3]))
for row in res[:10]:
    print(row)
